allocation: allocated_minor is in the invoice currency; for a payment in another currency it equals convert(amount_minor, payment->invoice currency, rate of the payment's local date) with the rounding below
fx_rate_direction: units of target_currency per 1 unit of source_currency
ledger_application: payment documents are applied to invoices in the ledger: account 1200 credit per invoice; any part not applied sits on account 2100
period_boundary: period_start..period_end inclusive, in the manifest timezone; records dated after period_end are the next period
